leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the structure of an analytics event.
Implement a typed array to catalog multiple analytics events with consistent properties.
Apply union types to categorize events into distinct, predefined groups.
Manipulate event data by adding and updating entries in the typed catalog.
Initialize and render a function that processes and logs events from the catalog.
Integrate type guards to validate event categories at runtime.
Configure a reusable utility function to generate standardized event payloads.
